title: Sparkly kite
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='kiteGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ff5b7f'/>
      <stop offset='50%' stop-color='#ffd166'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#4fc3f7'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- kite tail -->
  <path d='M50 78 Q46 84 52 88 Q58 92 50 97' stroke='#ff9a3c' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <path d='M46 84 L54 88' stroke='#ff5b7f' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M53 90 L59 86' stroke='#4fc3f7' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- kite body -->
  <polygon points='50,10 78,42 50,78 22,42' fill='url(#kiteGrad)'/>
  <!-- kite cross bars -->
  <line x1='50' y1='10' x2='50' y2='78' stroke='#ffe9a8' stroke-width='2'/>
  <line x1='22' y1='42' x2='78' y2='42' stroke='#ffe9a8' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- lower quadrants shading -->
  <polygon points='50,42 78,42 50,78' fill='#ff5b7f' opacity='0.55'/>
  <polygon points='50,42 50,78 22,42' fill='#ffd166' opacity='0.55'/>

    <path d='M12 58 L13.5 62 L17.5 63.5 L13.5 65 L12 69 L10.5 65 L6.5 63.5 L10.5 62 Z'/>
    <circle cx='30' cy='20' r='1.8'/>
    <circle cx='70' cy='18' r='1.8'/>
    <circle cx='88' cy='44' r='1.8'/>
    <circle cx='10' cy='40' r='1.8'/>
    <circle cx='34' cy='88' r='1.5'/>
    <circle cx='72' cy='84' r='1.5'/>
  </g>
  <g fill='#8ef1ff' opacity='0.85'>
    <circle cx='24' cy='30' r='1.2'/>
    <circle cx='76' cy='54' r='1.2'/>
    <circle cx='20' cy='74' r='1.2'/>
    <circle cx='80' cy='76' r='1.2'/>
  </g>
</svg>
